title: Flat-term derived square for quotient section pull transport
statement: Given normalized endpoint ScalarSectionData, a PullNormalized internal comparison, its conjugated derived section comparison barLam, and an ordinary square e, the scalar-model derived computation equation holds on every flat-term K-flat complex.

lean.statement: theorem section_pull_transport_kflat_derived {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y) (hcX : ScalarSectionNormalized a X cX) (hcY : ScalarSectionNormalized a Y cY) (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X) (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam) (barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅ derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T) (e : cY.model.E ⋙ pullback Λ' f ≅ pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E) (he : ∀ M : Modules Λ Y, (equivalence Λ' X).functor.map ((CondensedRing.pullIso a f).inv.app M) ≫ cX.ordinary.hom.app ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).obj M) ≫ cX.model.E.map ((pullComparison Λ f).hom.app M) = (pullComparison Λ' f).hom.app ((QuotientChange.extension a Y).obj M) ≫ (pullback Λ' f).map (cY.ordinary.hom.app M) ≫ e.hom.app ((equivalence Λ Y).functor.obj M)) : ∀ P : CochainComplex (modules Λ Y) ℤ, (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P → (∀ i : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X i)) → barLam.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ cX.model.T.map ((pullback Λ f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫ cX.model.ε.app (((pullback Λ f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) = (derivedPullback Λ' f).map (cY.model.ε.app P) ≫ (pullback Λ' f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((cY.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso e (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
